title: Sicilian-Style Lemon Granita
summary: Zesty, refreshing lemon granita made from fresh lemon juice and scraped into crystalline flakes, intensely bright and thirst-quenching.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Put the metal tin in the freezer. Cut the peel and white pith off 7 lemons, chop the flesh and remove the seeds.

steps.title: Process
steps.text: Process the lemon flesh with 120 ml water, 200 g sugar and ⅛ tsp fine salt until very smooth, about 1 min.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Strain into a jug, pressing hard; discard solids. Stir in the remaining 360 ml water and taste to ensure the mixture is bright, sweet and sharp.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pour into the cold tin and freeze on a flat shelf.

steps.title: Rake
steps.text: After 45 min, rake the frozen edges into the middle with a fork. Repeat every 30 min until fluffy, separate crystals form with no liquid remaining, 3-4 h total, or freeze solid overnight and scrape into flakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scrape again just before serving into chilled glasses.

tips: Rake the granita every 30 minutes to create evenly sized ice crystals throughout
Taste the mixture after straining and adjust if needed so it is bright, sweet and sharp
Serve immediately in chilled glasses for the best granular texture
storage: Serve immediately after scraping, or freeze uncovered and scrape again just before serving.
